newsitem.title: USA: Tennessee abandons matching requirement for grants.
newsitem.headline: Tennessee abandons matching requirement for grants.

text.p: Tennessee Gov. Don Sundquist's administration has abandoned an attempt to make local governments pay half the cost of a program that awards grants to new or expanding industries, the Knoxville News-Sentinel said Tuesday.
Sundquist's proposed budget provided $10 million for the Tennessee Infrastructure Improvement Program and included a bill requiring local governments to furnish $5 million.
Municipal governments had lobbied against the proposal. On Monday, House Speaker Jimmy Naifeh said Sundquist's administration had not asked for the bill to be put on notice for a vote.
Finance Commissioner John Ferguson said Sundquist is seeking an alternate source of funding to make up the $5 million.
